## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include how this should work from a user's perspective.

## Alternative Solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Impact

- **Users affected:** [e.g., All users, trainers only, students]
- **Priority:** [Low / Medium / High / Critical]
- **Effort estimate:** [Small / Medium / Large]
